Android

Google Play closed test

Required for Android production access. Please opt in with your Gmail account and keep the app installed/opted in for 14 days.

Join Android test Install Android app
  1. Open the join link with your Gmail account.
  2. Tap Become a tester or Join.
  3. Install Aethon Beacon from Google Play.
  4. Keep tester opt-in active for 14 days.
iOS

Apple TestFlight

Install Apple’s TestFlight app first. Aethon Beacon’s public TestFlight invite link will appear here once App Store Connect provides it.

Install TestFlight Request iOS invite
  1. Install TestFlight from the App Store.
  2. Request or open the Aethon Beacon TestFlight invite.
  3. Tap Accept, then install the beta build.
  4. Send feedback/screenshots from TestFlight or email.

Invite status: pending public TestFlight link from App Store Connect.

What to test

  1. App opens without crash.
  2. Voice input/readout works where supported.
  3. Message/beep/notification behavior feels clear.
  4. Vedic guidance is moon-chart based.
  5. Community/testing screens are understandable.
Feedback email: slathiarimple567@gmail.com. Android still needs 12 opted-in testers for 14 continuous days before production access.
